description:
A GPU-accelerated terminal for Windows that keeps your sessions alive.

Nebula is a terminal emulator for Windows, built in Rust on a GPU-accelerated rendering core and designed around one idea: your terminal sessions are too valuable to die with a window. It pairs a tmux-style resident session model with a glass UI, an AI-CLI-aware sidebar, and a shell experience that works without extra setup.
macOS, Linux, and Android downloads are Preview builds.
Fixed
- Fixed enabling launch at login on Windows when the user’s Startup folder is missing. Addresses #1028.
- Fixed pasting TIFF screenshots into terminal panes. Addresses #1016.
- Fixed Windows upgrades and uninstalls removing user-edited WSL context menu registry entries.
- Fixed opening a directory in an existing elevated Windows window ignoring the configured default shell profile. Addresses #1042.
- Fixed SSH agent hooks dropping a complete answer that fits the message limit when unrelated tool output makes the event too large.
- Fixed local OMP conversations losing their session on restart. On Windows with PowerShell 7, reopening Pebrel restores the same conversation after a normal close or forced exit. Addresses #1027.
- Fixed Windows terminal tabs losing their previous output when waking from sleep. Addresses #992.
- Fixed Windows ignoring the esc alias when configured as the shortcut to minimize the window.
- Fixed Windows upgrades leaving the WSL context menu pointed at the previous installation directory.
- Fixed SFTP browsing after a cached channel closes. SSH image paste now retries a temporary channel refusal once before starting the upload.
- Fixed reopening Pebrel to an idle shell when automatic Codex recovery is enabled and a saved tab has no thread ID. The tab now opens the Codex conversation picker.
- Fixed a close confirmation acting on the wrong tab or split when its position changed while the dialog was open.
